title: UXID conformance case: encode
description: One line of encode.json: the inputs of a time-based id and the id a producer emits for them. The delimiter is `_`.

id.description: Stable case id, `encode/` and a slug.

prefix.description: The prefix; null for none. An empty string is no prefix too.

compact.description: Compact time (40 bits) when true, standard time (48 bits) when false.

case.description: The letter case of the body.

rand.description: The random field's bytes as lowercase hex, exactly the random width of the size and mode.
